comment: The third colour. These are POLICY refusals, decided on the record -- the sweep must report them as REFUSED-ON-PURPOSE and may never rediscover them as defects. A refusal turning up as LEFT_BEHIND in sweep output is a bug in the instrument, not in the app. policy_ref (pt.5 rule b, the xfail parent's known rot): every refusal must cite the policy doc it rests on -- file must exist in-repo AND the section heading must still be present, or CI goes red. A refusal may not outlive its policy.

refusals.why: no data source the app can verify; a wrong 'accessible' strands someone at a staircase
occupancy forecasts are unverifiable marketing-grade data
prices unverifiable; zone NAMES shipped instead (checkable), validity claims refused
refusals.covers_extended: 2026-08-05: the three fare-class personas added -- their DEFINING need (halbtax/seven25/student discounts) is exactly the price claim this refusal declines. Same move as step-free covering parent-pram/wheelchair-user. Flagged to the operator in the sweep report; revert by removing the three who/ values if the personas are ruled to mean something else.
